implementation_name: Frozen Starrydata reverse-transport prediction and OOD-policy implementation
outcome_status_at_freeze: target ZT column not loaded; target identities, metadata, source predictions, fixed ranks, policy orders, and hypothesis cards only
claim_guard: All named methods, controls, endpoints, and multiplicity families remain in the result regardless of sign. No winning learner, representation, source, or policy may replace a prespecified primary after outcome access.

target_join.procedure: For every frozen curve_row and selected_position, parse the y list at that position, require equal x/y list lengths and finite 0 <= ZT <= 10, then take the median over eligible curves for each frozen entity_id.
exclusions: entity with no remaining selected value
minimums: 20 observed evaluation entities in every primary scope

target_label_sampling.selection: SHA-256 ordered components with deterministic nearest-budget completion; no target outcome stratification

evaluation_scopes.required_surface: all four frozen evaluation OOD quartiles

representations.composition: 118 element fractions plus eight scale-invariant composition descriptors
representations.composition_context: composition representation plus 64 deterministic signed-hash features from sample_name, sample_info, and composition_details; article, DOI, SID, curve identity, and target outcome are forbidden

prediction_primary_family.endpoint: paired relative RMSE reduction in primary_hard_ood at n=30
prediction_primary_family.primary_cell: ExtraTrees with the composition representation; all other learner-representation cells are mandatory robustness results
prediction_primary_family.multiplicity: Holm over the three named contrasts
prediction_primary_family.robustness: same effect direction in at least two of three learners and both representations; every cell reported

matched_specificity_controls.source_size: For each ionic source and wrong source pair, refit both on the smaller entity count using deterministic group-preserving SHA-256 subsamples; compare their target-rank increment on identical target splits.
matched_specificity_controls.source_skill: Use the wrong source with closest grouped OOF Spearman; an absolute difference <= 0.05 is a passed match, otherwise degrade the higher-skill source by a frozen convex mixture with a group-permuted label until the closest 0.05 grid point is reached.
matched_specificity_controls.target_coverage: Compute nearest-source composition distance for every target entity; within each source, weight or group-subsample source entities until target-distance decile frequencies match the nominated source within maximum standardized difference 0.10.
matched_specificity_controls.capacity: Append five pre-frozen random features, equal to the five real source channels, and fit with the same learner, split, and hyperparameters.
matched_specificity_controls.shuffle: Independently permute the two ionic ranks once with the pre-frozen seed; do not search over shuffles.

exploration.top_component_definition: top ceil(5 percent) connected components ranked by maximum observed entity ZT; median and mean component outcomes are required sensitivities
co_primary: acquisitions to first distinct top component
mandatory_tradeoffs: marginal unique top components from OBELiX and Caltech
exploration.multiplicity: Holm over six named contrasts per co-primary endpoint

hypothesis_cards.primary_test: paired difference in median ZT between every frozen candidate set and its OOD-distance-matched target-only controls
hypothesis_cards.reporting: every card, control, falsifier, and failure is retained

inference.prediction: paired two-level bootstrap of target-label repeat and evaluation provenance/component block, 10,000 resamples
inference.exploration: 10,000 component-block bootstraps plus 5,000 independent source-rank permutations
inference.external_boundary: This is one independent dataset-level target. Seed or component intervals do not substitute for the planned multi-target random-effects analysis.

compute.parallel_unit: repeat x budget x learner x representation
compute.required_completion: row-count arithmetic, input/design/sentinel hashes, seed coverage, finite predictions, policy permutation checks, and COMPLETE sentinel
